name: PMI.org Redesign
one_liner: Built a modern, responsive front-end for PMI's Agile certification site to clarify the value and make the path to certification easier to follow.
projectSummary: Redesigned and rebuilt the PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (ACP) page with a clearer structure, modern UI, and accessible, responsive components.

problem.summary: The existing ACP page was text-heavy, difficult to skim, and visually outdated. Key certification details and benefits were hard for users to quickly understand, especially on mobile.

goals: Improve clarity and readability of ACP certification information
Create a modern, responsive UI aligned with PMI’s evolving brand
Translate detailed Figma designs into stable, accessible components
Enhance structure and hierarchy for easier content understanding
responsibilities: Built modular React components based on detailed design specifications
Developed responsive layouts with strong typographic hierarchy
Collaborated with designers to refine spacing, readability, and interaction details
Ensured accessibility compliance across all UI elements
Worked with back-end engineers to integrate structured content cleanly
Conducted device testing to confirm consistency across breakpoints
outcomes: Delivered a modern, responsive ACP page aligned with PMI’s updated brand
Improved clarity and communication of key certification details
Created reusable components for future PMI site updates
Enhanced accessibility and readability for content-heavy pages
